summary: Enerflex Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with its Q2 2026 earnings press release and interim financial statements. The release reports adjusted EBITDA of $128 million, free cash flow of $32 million, return on capital employed of 15.4%, and a book-to-bill ratio of 1.5x with ES backlog at $1.5 billion. There is no M&A, buyback, or other special-situations event disclosed; it is a routine quarterly financial reporting filing by a foreign private issuer.
